description: This file defines the class nl80211_client_whm, which implements NL80211 client methods for wireless interface management using a shared connection. It includes method declarations for retrieving interface, radio, station, survey info, setting tx power, channel scan control, key management, station addition, and DELBA frame sending. It imports dependencies on nl80211_client and ambiorix_connection.

classes.name: nl80211_client_whm
classes.description: Implements NL80211 client methods for wireless network management using wbapi shared connection.

methods.name: get_interfaces
methods.description: Retrieves a list of wireless interface names.

methods.name: get_interface_info
methods.description: Gets detailed information about a specified wireless interface.

methods.name: get_radio_info
methods.description: Obtains radio capabilities and supported channels for a specified interface.

methods.name: get_sta_info
methods.description: Retrieves station information such as MAC address and connection details.

methods.name: get_survey_info
methods.description: Provides survey information, typically about channel usage, here returns fixed info for 2.4GHz.

methods.name: set_tx_power_limit
methods.description: Sets the transmit power limit for a radio interface.

methods.name: get_tx_power_dbm
methods.description: Retrieves the current transmit power in dBm for a radio.

methods.name: add_key
methods.description: Adds a security key for a specified interface.

methods.name: add_station
methods.description: Manually adds/stations a station to an interface using assoc request data.

methods.name: get_key
methods.description: Retrieves key info such as MAC and key index.

methods.name: send_delba
methods.description: Sends a DELBA (Delete Block Acknowledgement) frame to a station.
